findings.title: HumainX Quick Start wizard hardcodes destination to /dashboard/creator upon completion
findings.observedBehaviour: In handleFinalSubmit of HumainXQuickStartInner, completion executes router.replace('/dashboard/creator') without checking searchParams.get('returnTo').
findings.expectedBehaviour: If a user lands on the Quick Start wizard with a returnTo param, it should return to returnTo if provided and validated.
findings.userImpact: Phase 4 deflection properly routes users to /dashboard/creator/profile (which does handle returnTo correctly), so users deflected from Phase 4 are not affected. However, if a user directly navigated to /dashboard/creator/humainx?returnTo=..., they would return to the main dashboard rather than returnTo.
findings.smallestCorrection: In src/app/dashboard/creator/humainx/page.tsx, read returnTo from useSearchParams and navigate to (returnTo || '/dashboard/creator').

findings.title: Legacy test assertion expects /dashboard/creator/profile to redirect to /dashboard/profile
findings.observedBehaviour: CreatorStabilization02.test.tsx imports a mock redirect component expecting CreatorProfileRedirect() to call redirect('/dashboard/profile'). In production, /dashboard/creator/profile is the active 10-step HumainX Profile Builder page.
findings.expectedBehaviour: Test suite should reflect the modern HumainX Profile Builder component rather than legacy redirect mock.
findings.userImpact: No runtime user impact; test artifact legacy mismatch.
findings.smallestCorrection: Update CreatorStabilization02.test.tsx to assert HumainX Profile Builder rendering rather than legacy redirect.

findings.title: CREATOR_ROUTE_ALIASES maps /dashboard/creator/profile to /dashboard/profile for sidebar highlighting
findings.observedBehaviour: CREATOR_ROUTE_ALIASES defines '/dashboard/creator/profile': '/dashboard/profile'. When on the HumainX Profile Builder, the sidebar active state highlights Account Profile in the bottom menu.
findings.expectedBehaviour: Sidebar active item could optionally highlight a dedicated Creator Profile entry if added to main menu.
findings.userImpact: Sidebar visual highlight reflects Account Profile; functionality and form submission are 100% operational.
findings.smallestCorrection: Leave as intentional alias or add explicit submenu mapping if Creator navigation demands distinct highlight.
